title: Add account
description: Choose how to sign in or what to import.
relogin.title: Sign in again
relogin.target: Sign in again as {name}. The account keeps its nickname, notes, tags, priority, weight, proxy, stats and history.
relogin.singleOnly: Signing in again takes one credential. Paste only one.
relogin.mismatchTitle: Switch this account to another user?
relogin.mismatchBody: You signed in as {incoming}, but this account is {current}. Switching moves the account to {incoming}. It keeps its nickname, notes, tags, priority, weight, proxy, stats and history.
relogin.mismatchDeclined: Nothing changed. The new sign-in was discarded.
relogin.unverified: Could not confirm that this sign-in is the same user.
relogin.otherAccount: This sign-in belongs to {name}, another account in the pool. This account was not changed.
